logical_scratch.mirror: updated only on actual successful physical write ACK; never drives ready, response or pixels

display_lease.source: validated accepted descriptor captured at actual RGB engine start; ID/bank/epoch/full generation remain immutable
start_preconditions: key is actually front/presented and pending empty before key display
source candidate and scratch completed before its display start
no already accepted aliasing candidate physical write
display_lease.new_candidate_handshake: request valid and ready both gated by display_candidate_allowed
display_lease.publication_drain: external hint AND actual consumer lease/engine/display reader/physical reader drain
display_lease.first_rgb: key overlaps next native delta decoder
display_lease.last_rgb: delta drained after key lease closure
display_lease.full64_generation: explicit reject if RGB32 cannot represent the accepted generation; no truncation
display_lease.guard: separate seed912901/tAC2 finite last-pixel hold through deltaCOMMIT+17clocks; excluded from performance

pin_receipts.integrity: whole-stream raw SHA256 plus per-chunk raw and compressed SHA256
